sectors.sector_macro_thesis: Spot LNG and APM prices mein correction se CGD players jaise MGL ko raw material cost par rahat mil rahi hai, jisse unke margins sustain ho rahe hain. Halanki upstream producers ke liye lower realization headwinds create kar raha hai, par downstream distributors ke liye yeh ek favorable cost structure establish kar raha hai.

evaluated_stocks.operational_transmission_rationale: Delhi-NCR me CNG retail pricing power ke chalte lower gas sourcing cost ka direct benefit margins me reflect hoga.
evaluated_stocks.quarterly_ebitda_outlook: Lower gas input costs ke karan upcoming quarters me EBITDA per scm me positive expansion dekhne ko milega.

evaluated_stocks.operational_transmission_rationale: Strong 22% OPM aur negative working capital (-11 days CCC) ke sath MGL rapidly falling gas costs ko bottom line me convert kar rahi hai.
evaluated_stocks.quarterly_ebitda_outlook: Industrial demand ki stability aur favorable sourcing mix se Q3/Q4 me strong profitability maintain rahegi.

evaluated_stocks.operational_transmission_rationale: Regulated domestic gas prices aur global gas price softening ke karan upstream realisations dabav me hain.

evaluated_stocks.quarterly_ebitda_outlook: Realisation drop aur inventory holding drag ki wajah se near-term margins contraction mode me rahenge.

sectors.sector_macro_thesis: ATF prices me sharp spike (Brent 113+ USD/bbl) airlines ke operational costs ko buri tarah crush kar raha hai, kyunki fuel cost total expenses ka 40% tak hota hai. Downstream oil refiners bhi inventory gains ke bawujud high crude volatility ke chalte retail pricing caps ke dabav me hain.

evaluated_stocks.operational_transmission_rationale: Fortnightly fuel burn par high ATF prices ka direct heavy blow pad raha hai jise fares me fully pass-on karna tough hai.
evaluated_stocks.quarterly_ebitda_outlook: Rising fuel expenses aur dollar lease headwinds ki wajah se upcoming results me severe margin pressure dikhega.

evaluated_stocks.operational_transmission_rationale: Weak pricing power aur high dollar lease rentals ke sath soaring ATF cost company ki financial viability ko test kar rahi hai.
evaluated_stocks.quarterly_ebitda_outlook: High fuel burn aur cash flow constraints ke chalte operating losses widen hone ka pura risk hai.

evaluated_stocks.operational_transmission_rationale: Crude oil me 1M jump (10.87%) ke bawujud retail auto fuel price freezes refining marketing margins ko squeeze kar rahe hain.
evaluated_stocks.quarterly_ebitda_outlook: Marketing margins par cap hone ke karan upcoming quarters me core operational profitability dabav me rahegi.

evaluated_stocks.operational_transmission_rationale: High auto fuel exposure aur volatile crude input costs downstream marketing segment ke margins ko negatively hit kar rahe hain.
evaluated_stocks.quarterly_ebitda_outlook: Inventory valuation gains ke alawa core marketing margins me significant contraction expected hai.

sectors.sector_macro_thesis: Crude naphtha aur benzene prices mein sharp jump (1Y delta 74.8%) ki wajah se raw material input costs spike ho chuke hain. evaluated_stocks.operational_transmission_rationale: Formula-linked contracts aur 123% CFO/OP ke chalte yeh raw material cost hikes ko asani se clients par load kar sakte hain.
evaluated_stocks.quarterly_ebitda_outlook: Strong contractual pass-through mechanism ki wajah se operating margins mein stable expansion rahegi.

evaluated_stocks.operational_transmission_rationale: High-margin fluorine CDMO model aur 122% CFO/OP hone ke karan commodity crude shocks ka inke portfolio par minimal negative impact padta hai.
evaluated_stocks.quarterly_ebitda_outlook: Niche product mix aur pricing power ki wajah se EBITDA margins upar ki taraf hi rahenge.

evaluated_stocks.operational_transmission_rationale: Strong backward integration aur 122% CFO/OP ke sath, ye rising PVC resin prices ka fida apne captive production se uthate hain.

evaluated_stocks.operational_transmission_rationale: 87 din ki inventory aur 115 din ke lambe CCC cycle ki wajah se raw material cost hike ko reflect karne mein delay hota hai.

evaluated_stocks.operational_transmission_rationale: Global delivery pricing power aur specialized product portfolio ki wajah se raw material inflation ka asar margins par nahi padta.

sectors.sector_macro_thesis: Iron ore aur coking coal ke prices me correction (-1.51% 1M, -14.3% 1Y) primary steelmakers ke raw material cost pressure ko ease kar raha hai.
